universes.name: Prime Universe
universes.description: The primary continuity where the events of Night Watch and the Eclipse Wars unfold.

universes.name: Alternate Epoch (Future 2099)
universes.description: A dark dystopian timeline where the Black Sun syndicate rules New Lagos.

planets.name: Earth
planets.description: Cradle of humanity and ground zero for meta-human awakenings following the Eclipse Incident.

locations.name: New Lagos
locations.description: A sprawling vertical metropolis humming with neon cyber-kinetics and ancient mystical wards.
locations.history: Rebuilt after the 2026 Black Tower explosion.

locations.name: Black Tower
locations.description: Orbital-anchored monolith serving as the base of operations for the Night Watch.

characters.name: Marcus Vale
characters.distinguishingFeatures: Cybernetic optic nerve scar over left eye.
characters.costume: Matte-black ballisticweave tactical coat with kinetic dampeners.
characters.personality: Stoic, analytical, fiercely protective of civilians, haunted by his brother's disappearance.
weaknesses: Overloads when absorbing excessive kinetic feedback
characters.origin: Exposed to anomalous dark-matter radiation during the 2024 orbital eclipse.
characters.biography: Once a premier tactical officer for the Global Defense Accord, Marcus Vale forged the identity of Archer after discovering systemic corruption within the upper ranks. Now he protects the streets of New Lagos alongside the Night Watch.

teams.name: Night Watch
teams.goals: Protect New Lagos from meta-human corruption and uncover corporate cover-ups.
teams.history: Founded in the ashes of the Eclipse Incident.

organizations.name: Black Sun Syndicate
organizations.resources: High-grade cybernetics, illegal neurotoxins, smuggled alien tech.
organizations.goals: Overthrow the New Lagos council and monopolize dark-matter energy.
organizations.influence: High in the undercity, covertly infiltrating corporate boards.

powers.name: Kinetic Energy Absorption
powers.description: Absorbs physical impacts and kinetic force, storing it within cellular muscle fibers for explosive physical release or energy discharge.
powers.limitations: Maximum absorption threshold before muscular tearing occurs.

powers.name: Neurotoxic Secretion
powers.description: Produces complex synthetic neurotoxins capable of paralyzing motor functions within 3.4 seconds of epidermal contact.
powers.limitations: Requires 12 hours to synthesize a full dose after depletion.

artifacts.name: Eclipse Bow
artifacts.creator: Unknown Pre-Collapse Artisan
artifacts.origin: Retrieved from the wreckage of orbital station Daedalus.
artifacts.abilities: Materializes quantum arrows formed from ambient dark matter when drawn.
artifacts.history: Bonded to Archer's biometric signature during the Eclipse Incident.

events.name: Black Tower Siege
events.consequences: Viper escapes with encrypted quantum drives; Black Tower defense grid upgraded.

issues.title: Shadows Over New Lagos
issues.synopsis: Viper launches a surprise assault on the Black Tower while Archer investigates anomalies in the undercity.

relationships.description: Founder and current leader of the taskforce.
Bitterness stemming from the Genesis Project tragedy and subsequent terrorist attacks.

scripts.description: Heavy cyber-rain pours over glowing neon pagoda spires. A lone figure stands perched on the gargoyle ridge of the Black Tower.

dialogue.text: The rain doesn't wash away the blood, Nova. It just makes it conduct better.

scripts.narration: New Lagos. Year 2026 of the Post-Eclipse Epoch. The city breathes in neon and exhales smoke.
scripts.artistNote: Emphasize verticality and glowing cyan neon against obsidian armor.

scripts.description: Nova's fingers fly across holographic touch-displays as alarm runes flare red.

dialogue.text: Archer, we've got an unauthorized quantum signature breaching Sector 4! It's Viper's bio-signature.

scripts.artistNote: Warm amber glow from holographic displays contrasting with cold blue room lighting.

artwork.title: Archer Official Character Sheet
artwork.notes: Updated tactical coat with kinetic weave lines.
